station_count_rule: default counts x total/25, largest remainder, at least one per type; remainder ties to the larger default count, then STATION_TYPES order
pairing: classes, module weights, routes, nominal durations and waits of the source order; the first k stations of each type keep the source processing times; added stations draw nominal x U(0.8, 1.2) from the separate stream; removed stations drop their column
purpose: out-of-distribution test set: 50x25+ppvc-mixed on a 30-station factory
